listing.name: SimCity (UrbanRecomp Enhanced)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for UrbanRecomp Enhanced; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Enhanced fork; upstream excludes interpreter from normal release, retains reference builds. Some cheat effects unconfirmed; full-game/device breadth Unknown. Enhanced fork of blackerking/UrbanRecomp; CPU interpreter excluded normal release, reference only. Assess independent maintenance; unsigned iOS needs user signing; not PC SimCity or SC2000. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux x64, macOS universal, Android ARM64/x86-64, unsigned iOS ARM64. iOS requires user signing. Original data: SNES SimCity1991 own compatible ROM. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
